d: Chayan Rastogi and Prashant Kapoor will discuss in this video... the big question ahead of the first ODI between India and New Zealand: What will Gautam Gambhir's Playing XI look like? With the ODI series about to begin, all eyes are on Team India's team selection, player combinations and strategy. Will Gambhir stick with the experienced players or give youngsters an opportunity? Who will make it into the playing XI, who might miss out, and what combination will give India the best chance of starting the series with a win? We'll analyse the possible Playing XI, discuss key selection…
